ask: Why is it on the path?
cards: The Tang monk who walked to India for scriptures and came back a legend.
A Venetian in the service of Kublai Khan, whose book gave Europe its picture of Asia.
Thirty years and some 120,000 kilometres across the Islamic world and beyond.
Treasure fleets to Arabia and Africa, decades before Europe rounded the Cape.
Four voyages that joined two worlds and began a catastrophe and an age at once.
The sea road to India, and the gun-backed trade empire that followed it.
The expedition that proved the world round by sailing it, though its commander never came home.
